title: Deckchair Care Welcome Café
venue: Gatley United Reformed Church, Elm Road, Gatley SK8 4LY
description: Deckchair Care's welcoming, dementia-friendly community café offers company, conversation and activities for older residents, carers and anyone who would enjoy some company. The listed sessions run 1pm–3pm. Dates are individually sourced; check with the organiser for any changes.

title: Memory Lane at Cheadle Hulme Methodist Church
venue: Cheadle Hulme Methodist Church, Ramillies Avenue, Cheadle Hulme SK8 7AL
cost: Free; advance discussion and registration required
description: A supportive group for people with dementia accompanied by their carers, with conversation, reminiscence and optional activities. This is not a walk-in event: contact the church office on 0161 485 1605 to discuss the group and registration before attending.

title: Bramall Hall decorated for Christmas: A Musical Celebration
venue: Bramall Hall, Hall Road, Bramhall, Stockport SK7 3NX
description: Bramall Hall's seasonal rooms have been decorated around Christmas music and songs, with floral arrangements by local volunteer groups. The event runs across 11–15 November, 11am–4.30pm, with last admission at 3.45pm. Walk-up tickets are available from the Museum Visitor Centre. Adult admission is £7, concessions £5.50, and children under 16 enter free.

title: Bramall Hall Decorated for Christmas: A Musical Celebration
venue: Bramall Hall, Hall Road, Bramhall, Stockport SK7 3NX
description: Festive decorations inspired by Christmas music fill historic Bramall Hall. Suitable for all ages. Walk-up tickets from the Museum Visitor Centre; last entry 3.45pm. The organiser lists 11–15 November at 11am–4.30pm; check any subsequent dates separately.

title: The Elf Trail at Bramall Hall
venue: Bramall Hall, Hall Road, Bramhall, Stockport SK7 3NX
cost: £3 per child; adult hall admission extra; online fee may apply
description: Children can search for hidden elves around Bramall Hall's decorated rooms and claim a small reward. The festive trail is aimed at children aged three and over, with sessions listed 11–15 November from 11am to 4.30pm. The £3 child trail charge is additional to any adult admission; check ticket and booking arrangements before travelling.

title: Christmas Craft Night at Cheadle Library
venue: Cheadle Library, 23 Ashfield Road, Cheadle, Stockport SK8 1BB
cost: Free; booking required; ages 16 and over
description: A free Christmas craft evening inspired by Agatha Christie and her connection to Cheadle. Make festive cards and decorations with a mystery, literary and Art Deco twist. The session is for ages 16 and over; book a place before travelling.

seo.access: For ages 16 and over. Booking is required even though the event is free.
seo.meta_description: Free Christmas Craft Night at Cheadle Library on 12 November 2026, 5.30–7pm. Agatha Christie-themed crafts for ages 16+. Book ahead.

title: Free Business Advice at Bramhall Library
venue: Bramhall Library, 70 Bramhall Lane South, Bramhall SK7 2DU
cost: Free; drop-in or book a one-hour adviser session
description: Meet advisers from the One Stockport Business Support Hub, GM Business Growth Hub, EnterprisingYou and Build a Business. Ask about business planning, funding, marketing, training or growth. Open to people considering a business and existing local operators.

title: Free Work and Skills Navigator drop-in at Bramhall Library
venue: Bramhall Library, 70 Bramhall Lane South, Bramhall SK7 2DU
description: Drop in for practical support with job hunting, CVs, applications, interviews, qualifications and career changes. The council calls this a monthly second-Thursday session; this listing is specifically for 12 November.

title: Journey to the Dark Side of the UNE
venue: Jodrell Bank, Bomish Lane, Lower Withington, Macclesfield SK11 9DW
description: UNE, the electronic dream-pop and ambient duo of Mark Radcliffe and Paul Langley, perform inside Jodrell Bank's Space Dome with full-dome visuals and a space conversation with Professor Tim O'Brien. Doors open at 7pm and the event runs 7:30pm to 10pm.

title: Oleanna at CHADS Theatre
venue: Chads Theatre Studio, Mellor Road, Cheadle Hulme SK8 5AU
description: David Mamet's challenging two-person drama Oleanna explores authority, accusations and competing interpretations of the same encounter. CHADS stages it in its intimate upstairs studio on Mellor Road, with Friday evening and Saturday matinee/evening performances among the advertised dates. The studio is reached by stairs. Check the specific performance and remaining seats before buying.

title: Storytime at Cheadle Library
venue: Cheadle Library, 23 Ashfield Road, Cheadle, Stockport SK8 1BB
description: A relaxed story and rhyme session for pre-school children with parents or carers at Cheadle Library. Check the council listing before travelling in case of changes.

title: Asian Food Night Market
venue: St Mary's Parish Church, Market Place, Stockport
cost: Free entry; food and drink extra
description: Eat Good West's Asian food market brings street-food stalls and live entertainment to St Mary's Church in Stockport on Friday 13 November. This is a casual food-led evening rather than a seated restaurant booking, with different traders selling their own dishes. The earlier listing gave an evening slot to 10pm. Confirm traders and exact start time on the event page before making a special journey.

title: The Snowman: Live with Yorkshire Imperial Band
venue: Stockport Plaza, Mersey Square, Stockport SK1 1SP
description: Raymond Briggs' The Snowman is screened at Stockport's Art Deco Plaza on Friday 13 November at 7pm while Yorkshire Imperial Band performs Howard Blake's score live. The organisers also advertise a guest vocalist. A distinctive festive family night out combining film and live brass music. Current ticket prices, seats and access details are on the Plaza booking page.

title: Bramhall Early Festive Market
venue: Village Square, Bramhall, Stockport SK7 1AW
description: Worker Bee Markets brings local artisans, handmade gifts, Christmas decorations and food stalls to Bramhall Village Square on Saturday 14 November, 10am–3pm. Food options advertised include Mediterranean, Indian, Japanese, Nigerian and barbecue. There are children's activities and face painting too. Free entry, with purchases charged separately; check the organiser's latest arrangements.

title: Hannah Louise live at Cheadle Hulme Conservative Club
venue: Cheadle Hulme Conservative Club, Mellor Road, Cheadle Hulme SK8 5AT
description: Singer Hannah Louise is listed for Saturday 14 November at Cheadle Hulme Conservative Club, with an 8.45pm start. Members are admitted free according to the venue diary; non-members pay £5. This is a local Saturday evening music option requiring no trip into the city. Check the venue's latest diary and guest-entry arrangements before visiting.

title: Hat Works factory-floor tour
venue: Hat Works, Wellington Road South, Stockport
cost: Adults £8.50; under-16s free; booking fee may apply
description: Explore Stockport's industrial history on a behind-the-scenes factory-floor tour at Hat Works on Saturday 14 November, 10.30–11.30am. Discover the machinery and working processes behind the town's hat-making industry. The original listing recommends this for adults and children aged around eight or over. Check online ticket costs, access arrangements and availability before attending.

title: Northern Lights Lantern Parade: The Hare and the Moon
venue: Ashton Old Baths to Ashton Market Square, Ashton-under-Lyne
cost: Free to watch; market and fairground purchases extra
description: The Hare and the Moon procession leaves Ashton Old Baths at 5pm on Saturday 14 November, heading for the Market Square. A Christmas market and fairground begin from 11am, with music and community performances; fireworks are planned for around 6.30pm. The parade is free to watch. Check the route and final event programme before travelling, as the starting point is not the main square.

title: Pokémon GO: Rocket Takeover
venue: Viaduct Park, Stockport Interchange
description: A local Pokémon GO community meeting runs on Saturday 14 November at Viaduct Park by Stockport Interchange. The advertised day includes Team Rocket-themed challenges, raid opportunities and social play from 9.30am to 6pm. This is a game-related outdoor meet, so the experience assumes participants use Pokémon GO. Check organiser information for the exact meeting arrangement and any device requirements.

title: Seventy Years of Song
venue: St Michael and All Angels Church, Bramhall
description: St George's Singers mark their seventieth anniversary with a concert at St Michael and All Angels, Bramhall, on Saturday 14 November. The programme advertised music by Bach, Handel, Elgar and Rutter, giving choral-music fans a genuinely local evening. The concert is listed 7.30–9.30pm, with adult tickets £18 and reduced tickets £12 for students and children. Check the organiser's final programme and seats.

title: SUBTEXT: free film and collections workshop (ages 11–25)
venue: Stockroom Studios, Merseyway Shopping Centre, Stockport
description: Stockroom's free workshop with the North West Film Archive and artist Parham Ghalamdar uses personal objects and archive collections to inspire creative work. Young people aged 11–25 can bring a book, toy or keepsake and contribute to a hand-drawn film. There is an optional Doodle 'n Splice drop-in from noon to 12.45pm before the 1–3pm studio workshop. The venue lists lift access to the first floor.

title: Yuletide at Tatton Park
venue: Tatton Park, Knutsford, Cheshire
cost: 14 Nov listed: adults £19.50; children £11.50; under-2s free
description: This folklore-inspired outdoor Yuletide programme combines music and stories with an illuminated trail, performers, puppets, acrobatics and fire juggling. Allow around 90 minutes for the approximately 1km outdoor experience. Timed entry runs across the afternoon and evening; dress for November weather. Adult and child prices are those originally listed for 14 November, so verify the current basket and timed availability before booking.

title: A James Bond Concert Spectacular
venue: Stockport Plaza, Mersey Square, Stockport SK1 1SP
description: Q The Music performs the celebrated James Bond film themes at Stockport Plaza on Sunday 15 November at 7.30pm. Former Miss Moneypenny actor Caroline Bliss hosts, giving the concert a direct link to the films. Check the Plaza's booking page for current prices, seats and practical access information.

title: Dance Night at Cheadle Hulme Conservative Club
venue: Cheadle Hulme Conservative Club, Mellor Road, Cheadle Hulme SK8 5AT
description: The club's Sunday dance night offers DJ music and requests from 8pm on 15 November. It's a modestly priced local evening out rather than a major ticketed show, with an advertised £5 admission at the door. Check the current club diary and any entry conditions before turning up on Mellor Road.

title: Frozen: The Musical at Brookdale Youth Theatre
venue: Brookdale Theatre, Bramhall
description: Brookdale Youth Theatre presents the stage adaptation of Frozen between 15 and 21 November. Expect the story and familiar songs from the animated film, performed by a local youth company in Bramhall. Check the theatre's full programme for the exact performance dates, times, age guidance and ticket availability; the overall run does not mean a performance is scheduled every day.

title: Stockport's Spectacular Sunday
venue: Merseyway, Market Place, Underbanks and wider Stockport town centre
description: More than 200 performers and 50 free street shows transform Stockport town centre on Sunday 15 November, noon–5pm. See the giant Snow Lion, circus acts, the Miniscule of Sound nightclub, Hydropunk and a spectacular finale with over 100 drummers. Christmas lights switch-on is planned for 4.45pm. Performances are spread across several town-centre locations; check the council programme and access information.

title: Rope by Patrick Hamilton
venue: Players Theatre, Anfield Road, Cheadle Hulme
description: Players Theatre presents Patrick Hamilton's tense thriller Rope from 16 to 21 November. Two men hide a murder victim in a chest, then invite guests to a dinner party alongside the evidence. The advertised run includes evening performances and a Saturday matinee, making it a nearby option for fans of psychological theatre. Check the booking page for the actual performance nights and remaining seats.

title: Lum Head nursery and reception open day
venue: Lum Head Primary School, Troutbeck Road, Gatley SK8 4RR
description: Families considering nursery or reception places for September 2027 can look around Lum Head Primary School and meet staff. The school asks visitors to book a tour by calling 0161 428 7992 or emailing its school office.

seo.access: Public open day for families considering nursery or reception in September 2027. Book a place with the school before visiting.
seo.meta_description: Visit Lum Head Primary School in Gatley on 19 November 2026, 2–3pm, to explore nursery and reception places for 2027. Free; book your tour.

title: Manchester Art Fair
venue: Manchester Central, Manchester
cost: Friday–Sunday £15 + fee; Thursday preview £25; under-16s no ticket
description: Manchester Art Fair runs 19–22 November at Manchester Central, bringing more than 180 exhibitors, talks and a large selection of artworks to browse. Thursday is a separately ticketed preview; the regular public programme is Friday to Sunday. The original ticket listing gave £15 plus booking fee for public days and £25 for the preview. Check current conditions and any talk timings before booking.

title: Autisk After-School Play Zone
venue: Adswood Young People's Centre, Stockport SK3 8PH
description: Autisk's after-school family Play Zone offers gaming and VR headsets, crafts, a sensory room and activities for children of different ages and abilities. The session is advertised for Friday 20 November, 4–5.45pm, at Adswood Young People's Centre. Check with the organiser about entry arrangements, suitability and any particular accessibility needs ahead of the session.

title: Ignite Fire Festival
venue: Rochdale Town Hall Square and Gardens, Rochdale
description: Rochdale's Ignite Fire Festival runs 20–22 November, 5–8pm each evening. The 2026 event features Walk the Plank's BODY installation, a journey through six zones of fire, light, sound and effects. General attendance is listed as free with no booking; optional food and activities may cost extra. Expect bright lights, smoke and loud noise, which may matter for some visitors.

title: Liam Gallagher / Oasis tribute night
venue: Cheadle Hulme Conservative Club, Mellor Road, Cheadle Hulme SK8 5AT
description: Paul Hand performs a Liam Gallagher and Oasis tribute at Cheadle Hulme Conservative Club on Saturday 21 November. The club advertises an 8.45pm start, with members admitted free and non-members charged £5. A very local Saturday night of familiar Britpop songs; check the venue diary for any programme changes or guest-entry arrangements.

title: Manchester Coffee Festival
venue: Bowlers Exhibition Centre, Trafford Park, Manchester
cost: Ticketed; parking £10 a day; child-ticket rules apply
description: Manchester Coffee Festival takes place at Bowlers Exhibition Centre on Saturday 21 and Sunday 22 November. Visitors can try speciality coffee, browse roasters and enjoy talks, competitions and DJs. The organiser states public ticket holders receive samples; ticket prices vary by session, and parking is listed as £10 per day. Friday 20 November is for the trade, not ordinary public admission.
date_range: Saturday 21 and Sunday 22 November; public sessions

title: Moya Cole Hospice Christmas clearance sale
venue: Unit A1, Bankfield Industrial Estate, Coronation Street, Reddish, Stockport
description: Moya Cole Hospice's Christmas clearance sale offers decorations, toys and bric-a-brac at 50p or less on Saturday 21 November, 9–11am. The sale takes place at Unit A1, Bankfield Industrial Estate, Coronation Street in Reddish, with proceeds supporting the hospice. Stock is naturally limited, so arrive within the advertised window and check the organiser listing before travelling.

title: Romiley Christmas lights day
venue: Romiley Forum and The Precinct, Romiley, Stockport
description: Romiley's festive celebration on Saturday 21 November is advertised from 11am to 6pm, with market stalls, community performances, choirs, brass bands, theatre and Father Christmas. It offers an afternoon of activities rather than only a lights countdown. The precise switch-on time was not included in the original listing, so check local updates if that is the main reason for your trip.

title: Superheroes and princesses at Bramhall Village Square
venue: Village Square, Bramhall, Stockport SK7 1AW
description: Bramhall Village Square advertises a family event with superheroes, princesses, face painting and character meet-and-greets on Saturday 21 November, 11am–3pm. A Disney Princess singalong is advertised for 2pm. Entry is free, making it an easy half-day local option. Check the organiser's latest event post for which characters are scheduled and any changes to activities.

title: Woodbank Winter Gathering
venue: Woodbank Community Food Hub, Offerton, Stockport
cost: Free entry; £25 wreath workshops and other purchases extra
description: Woodbank Community Food Hub's winter gathering offers festive stalls, refreshments, gingerbread decorating and wreath-making activities supporting a local community project. Entry is free, while workshops and purchases cost extra. It begins at 11am on Saturday 21 November. The original organiser pages gave differing finish times, so check the latest update before planning around a closing time.

title: Stockport Foodie Friday
venue: Market Place and Great Underbank, Stockport SK1 1EW
cost: Free to enter; food and drink extra
description: Foodie Friday returns to central Stockport on Friday 27 November from 6pm to 9pm. Independent food stalls, craft ales, cocktails and music spread around Market Place and Great Underbank. This November edition is advertised with a Bollywood theme, while trader line-ups may change. No general admission charge applies, but food and drinks are extra. Check the current programme before travelling.

title: The Flying Coach Monthly Market
venue: The Flying Coach, 120 London Road, Hazel Grove, Stockport
description: The Flying Coach's monthly market in Hazel Grove runs on Saturday 28 November, 10am–4pm, featuring independent traders with handmade goods, gifts and sweet treats. Free entry makes it convenient for browsing local makers before Christmas. The venue is 120 London Road, and stalls may change from one month to another. Check the organiser's published details before setting off.

title: Heald Green Christmas Market and Lights
venue: Car park behind 232–234 Finney Lane, Heald Green, Cheadle SK8 3QA
description: Heald Green's Christmas Market and lights event takes place on Sunday 29 November in the car park behind 232–234 Finney Lane. The listing advertises local stalls and entertainment between 11am and 4pm, with a festive lights switch-on as part of the day. General entry is free; shopping and food cost extra. The exact switch-on time has not been confirmed in the council listing.

title: Jack and the Beanstalk at Heald Green Theatre
venue: Heald Green Theatre, Motcombe Grove (off Styal Road), Heald Green SK8 3TW
cost: Tickets on sale; check live booking page for current price
description: Heald Green Theatre’s annual pantomime runs Monday 30 November to Sunday 6 December. Monday to Friday performances are at 7.30pm; Saturday and Sunday have 1.30pm and 6.30pm shows. Tickets are on sale through the theatre’s booking route.
